title: docs(ui): give the compare-widget date dimension example its synonyms
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34874

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

#34822 (merged `d576509c80`) delivered the rest of the card: both full `defineDataset` examples on the two pages, the "Give every member its vocabulary" bullet, and the `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` rule itself. This PR covers the last two examples the rule would still flag, one on each page.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`dashboards.mdx`「对比组件的日期键」示例中的 `close_date` 维度,和 `analytics.mdx`「时长度量」示例中的 `avg_hours_to_resolve` 度量,都补上了 `synonyms`。
- 为什么改:两处示例都只有名称,没有 synonyms 和 description,正是 `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` 会提示的写法。作者照抄就会收到警告。
- 风险与回滚:纯文档,两个代码片段共 +9/-2 行;回滚即还原这两个文件。
- 先看:`content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` 约 :133 的时长度量片段,然后是 `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` 约 :523 的 `dimensions` 片段。
- 两分钟验证:打开 analytics 页「Duration measures」小节,应见 `synonyms: ['resolution time', 'time to resolve']`,`duration` 块不变;dashboards 页「The Date Key of a Compare Widget」小节,应见 `close_date` 带 `synonyms: ['closing date', 'date closed']`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx`, the snippet under "The Date Key of a Compare Widget": the `close_date` date dimension now declares `synonyms: ['closing date', 'date closed']`, in the style of the page's `salesDataset` example. Its `name` still equals the dashboard's `dateRange.field`, which is the snippet's point.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`, the example under "Duration measures": the `avg_hours_to_resolve` measure now declares `synonyms: ['resolution time', 'time to resolve']`. It is split over four lines; its `duration` block, the example's point, is unchanged.

## Why

Both examples declared a member with neither `synonyms` nor a `description`, exactly the shape `dataset-member-no-vocabulary` advises on (ADR-0149 D1). An author who copies either one publishes a member that a question asked in the user's own words cannot find.

## Patch round

Claim amendment 6955503178 added the `analytics.mdx` duration-measure line to this claim's surface, on seat 3's ruling. Commit `434c66c932` covers it, and the closing line is now `Fixes`.

## Acceptance notes

- No member declaration on either page now lacks both keys: the probe below reads every object-literal member array and standalone member fragment on both pages.
- No changeset: `content/docs/**` ships in no package's `files[]`; labelled `skip-changeset`.
